claims.text: After endovascular or surg revasc: ↓dose rivaroxaban 2.5 mg BID + low-dose ASA.
claims.quote: After endovascular or surgical revascularization for PAD, low-dose rivaroxaban (2.5 mg twice daily) combined with low-dose aspirin

claims.text: ALI: testing for a CV cause of thromboembolism can be useful;
claims.quote: In patients with ALI, testing for a cardiovascular cause of thromboembolism can be useful

claims.text: AF → anticoagulate per AF risk (CHA2DS2-VASc ≥2 men / ≥3 women).
claims.quote: For patients with AF and an estimated annual thromboembolic risk of ≥2% per year (eg, CHA2DS2-VASc score of ≥2 in men and ≥3 in women), anticoagulation is recommended to prevent stroke and systemic thromboembolism
